The '''central power core''' was the main [[Power core/Legends|power core]] that supplied energy to the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] world of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Designed by the ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], the core was powered by [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and was almost detonated by the [[Krannus's death cult|death cult]] of [[Executor (Sith Empire rank)|Executor]] [[Krannus]] in the service of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] before the [[Hero of Tython]] disabled the explosives.
